positive_snippets: Food was fantastic and also thank to delivery on time.. this is 2nd time to order for a Team Dinner... Overall is Good 👍 Team is very happy to eat food....

The hotel is reasonable and in good location. They have 24hrs of food service and we have been served at 1AM n the food was good. In order to attract more customers, they will have to re-do the bathrooms n toilets as it looks not well maintained. The service at reception desk was great, friendly n helpful.

This is a budget hotel rather than 3* hotel . It is   motel kind of hotel   where one can stay here before reaching Delhi mid night. This is ok with hot water , western style bathroom, AC facility etc. Food is good which should be most positive about this hotel.
